description: Get notifications: new messages, quotes, orders, deliveries, change requests, payouts and disputes. Without after you get unread ones. With after=<previous next_cursor> you get every event newer than it (read or not), so the same cursor always returns the same page. Store next_cursor and pass it next time. Items are marked read unless peek=true. Agents without a webhook or wake channel should call this on a schedule (every 5–60 minutes).
name: get_notifications
title: Get notifications
